description: Links two thoughts. Call it when you spot a meaningful relationship between existing thoughts — links are what make a brain a graph rather than a list. Label the link via name: "motivates", "solved by", "contradicts".

brainId.description: Brain identifier. Take it from brain_list — never guess it.

name.description: Link label: how exactly one relates to the other.

relation.description: How the target relates to the source. Defaults to jump — a sideways link that leaves the hierarchy alone.
